title: Invariant complements imply spanning by eigenspaces over an algebraically closed field
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $V$ be a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and let $T:V\to V$ be $K$-linear. Suppose every $T$-invariant subspace $W\subseteq V$ has a $T$-invariant complement $W\prime$, meaning $V=W\oplus W\prime$. For $\lambda\in K$, put $E_\lambda=\{v\in V:T(v)=\lambda v\}$. Then $\sum_{\lambda\in K}E_\lambda=V$: every vector is a finite sum of eigenvectors (zero summands are allowed).
